//: Solution-style config for `tsc -b`. dashboard-ui is intentionally absent: it is a noEmit, non-composite app built by `vp build` and typechecked by `vp check`. `packages/core` sits after every package it composes (store, dashboard-spec, upstream-http) and before `apps/server`, which composes it. The upstream adapter packages (zulip, forgejo, langfuse, openpanel, glitchtip, matomo, itsaplan) each declare `references` to `plugin-upstream-http` and `core`, so they are listed after both of those; `apps/server` stays last because it composes all of them.
